19555-bunny-brown-and-his-sister-sue-on-.title: On Grandpa'S Farm
19555-bunny-brown-and-his-sister-sue-on-.creator: Laura Lee Hope
19555-bunny-brown-and-his-sister-sue-on-.description: A book by Laura Lee Hope. "Oh, well, Mother, this is just my old doll," Sue answered. "It's the one I let Bunny take to play Punch and Judy show with, and he hit her with a stick, and made her sawdust come out. Did you want me, Mother?"

arxiv-2104-00698.title: Back to Square One: Superhuman Performance in Chutes and Ladders Through Deep Neural Networks and Tree Search
arxiv-2104-00698.creator: Dylan R. Ashley, Anssi Kanervisto, Brendan Bennett
arxiv-2104-00698.description: Abstract We present AlphaChute: a state-of-the-art algorithm that achieves superhuman performance in the ancient game of Chutes and Ladders . We prove that our algorithm converges to the Nash equilibrium in constant time, and therefore is—to the best of our knowledge—the first such formal solution to this game.

arxiv-2109-03931.title: Lie derivatives and structure Jacobi operator on real hypersurfaces in complex projective spaces II
arxiv-2109-03931.creator: Juan de Dios Pérez, David Pérez-López
arxiv-2109-03931.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Juan de Dios Pérez, David Pérez-López. Let M \displaystyle M be a real hypersurface in complex projective space. The almost contact metric structure on M \displaystyle M allows us to consider, for any nonnull real number k \displaystyle k , the corresponding k \displaystyle k -th generalized Tanaka-Webster connection on M \displaystyle M and, associated to it, a differential operator of first order of Lie type.

arxiv-2210-05460.title: Automorphisms of some variants of fine graphs
arxiv-2210-05460.creator: Frédéric Le Roux, Maxime Wolff
arxiv-2210-05460.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Frédéric Le Roux, Maxime Wolff. Recently Bowden, Hensel and Webb defined the fine curve graph for surfaces, extending the notion of curve graphs for the study of homeomorphism or diffeomorphism groups of surfaces. Later Long, Margalit, Pham, Verberne and Yao proved that for a closed surface of genus g ⩾ 2 g\geqslant 2 , the automorphism group of the fine graph is naturally isomorphic to the homeomorphism group of the surface.

arxiv-2305-05517.title: UAV-RIS-Aided Space-Air-Ground Integrated Network: Interference Alignment Design and DoF Analysis
arxiv-2305-05517.creator: Jingfu Li, Gaojie Chen, Senior Member, IEEE, Tong Zhang, Wenjiang Feng, Weiheng Jiang, Tony Q. S. Quek, Fellow, IEEE, Rahim Tafazolli, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2305-05517.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Jingfu Li, Gaojie Chen, Senior Member, IEEE, Tong Zhang, Wenjiang Feng, Weiheng Jiang, Tony Q. S. Quek, Fellow, IEEE, Rahim Tafazolli, Senior Member, IEEE. In space-air-ground integrated networks (SAGIN), receivers experience diverse interference from both the satellite and terrestrial transmitters. The heterogeneous structure of SAGIN poses challenges for traditional interference management (IM) schemes to effectively mitigate interference.

arxiv-2401-11519.title: CaBuAr: California Burned Areas dataset for delineation
arxiv-2401-11519.creator: Daniele Rege Cambrin, Luca Colomba, Paolo Garza
arxiv-2401-11519.description: Abstract Forest wildfires represent one of the catastrophic events that, over the last decades, caused huge environmental and humanitarian damages. In addition to a significant amount of carbon dioxide emission, they are a source of risk to society in both short-term (e.g., temporary city evacuation due to fire) and long-term (e.g., higher risks of landslides) cases.

arxiv-2408-02990.title: Joint Design of Probabilistic Constellation Shaping and Precoding for Multi-user VLC Systems
arxiv-2408-02990.creator: Thang K. Nguyen 1 , Thanh V. Pham 2 , Hoang D. Le 1 , Chuyen T. Nguyen 3 , and Anh T. Pham 1
arxiv-2408-02990.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Thang K. Nguyen 1 , Thanh V. Pham 2 , Hoang D. Le 1 , Chuyen T. Nguyen 3 , and Anh T. Pham 1. This paper proposes a joint design of probabilistic constellation shaping (PCS) and precoding to enhance the sum-rate performance of multi-user visible light communications (VLC) broadcast channels subject to signal amplitude constraint.

arxiv-2411-11394.title: InstruGen: Automatic Instruction Generation for Vision-and-Language Navigation Via Large Multimodal Models
arxiv-2411-11394.description: Abstract Recent research on Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) indicates that agents suffer from poor generalization in unseen environments due to the lack of realistic training environments and high-quality path-instruction pairs. Most existing methods for constructing realistic navigation scenes have high costs, and the extension of instructions mainly relies on predefined templates or rules, lacking adaptability.

arxiv-2501-03359.title: Aspects of a randomly growing cluster in ℝ d , d ≥ 2 \mathbb{R}^{d},d\geq 2
arxiv-2501-03359.creator: Alan Frieze, Ravi Kannan, Wesley Pegden
arxiv-2501-03359.description: Abstract We consider a simple model of a growing cluster of points in ℝ d , d ≥ 2 \mathbb{R}^{d},d\geq 2 . Beginning with a point X 1 X_{1} located at the origin, we generate a random sequence of points X 1 , X 2 , … , X i , … , X_{1},X_{2},\ldots,X_{i},\ldots, .

arxiv-2506-14015.title: Disentangling 3D from Large Vision-Language Models for Controlled Portrait Generation
arxiv-2506-14015.creator: Nick Yiwen HuangBrown UniversityAkin CaliskanFlawless AIBerkay KicanaogluFlawless AIJames TompkinBrown UniversityHyeongwoo KimImperial College London
arxiv-2506-14015.description: Abstract We consider the problem of disentangling 3D from large vision-language models, which we show on generative 3D portraits. This allows free-form text control of appearance attributes like age, hair style, and glasses, and 3D geometry control of face expression and camera pose.

arxiv-2511-15643.title: A Millennium of UK Business Cycles: Insights from Structural VAR Analysis Thanks: We thank participants of the Workshop in Empirical and Theoretical Economics at King’s College London for their useful comments. The views expressed in this paper are those of the authors and do not represent those of
arxiv-2511-15643.creator: Leonardo N. Ferreira, Haroon Mumtaz, Gabor Pinter
arxiv-2511-15643.description: Abstract We study macroeconomic fluctuations in the United Kingdom over seven centuries (1271–2022) using a time-varying VAR with stochastic volatility. We identify business cycle shocks as innovations explaining the largest share of future output variance. Before 1900, these shocks display a stagflationary, supply-driven pattern, while post-1900 shocks become demand-driven, raising both output and inflation.

europmc-pmc4510693.title: Gut microbiota mediate caffeine detoxification in the primary insect pest of coffee.
europmc-pmc4510693.creator: Ceja-Navarro JA, Vega FE, Karaoz U, Hao Z, Jenkins S, Lim HC, Kosina P, Infante F, Northen TR, Brodie EL.

plos-pone-0007067.creator: Adrian Zumsteg, Vanessa Baeriswyl, Natsuko Imaizumi et al.
plos-pone-0007067.description: PLOS ONE research article. The formation of new blood vessels (angiogenesis) and lymphatic vessels (lymphangiogenesis) promotes tumor outgrowth and metastasis. pmc-10503114.title: Co-infection of Plasmodium falciparum and Schistosoma mansoni is associated with anaemia
pmc-10503114.creator: Sylvester Donne Dassah, Kingsley Enock Nyaah, Dodzi Kwaku Jnr Senoo, Juventus B. Ziem, Yaw Aniweh, Lucas Amenga-Etego, Gordon A. Awandare, James Abugri
pmc-10503114.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundMalaria and schistosomiasis persist as major public health challenge in sub-Saharan Africa. These infections have independently and also in polyparasitic infection been implicated in anaemia and nutritional deficiencies. This study aimed at assessing asymptomatic malaria, intestinal Schistosoma infections and the risk of anaemia among school children in the Tono irrigation area in the Kassena Nankana East Municipal (KNEM) in the Upper East Region of Northern Ghana.MethodsA cross sectional survey of 326 school children was conducted in the KNEM.

pmc-11429071.title: “It Is as if I Gave a Gift to Myself”: A Qualitative Phenomenological Study on Working Adults’ Leisure Meaning, Experiences, and Participation
pmc-11429071.creator: Kubra Sahadet Sezer, Esra Aki, Gengfeng Niu
pmc-11429071.description: Leisure participation is a fundamental human and occupational right throughout life for working people, particularly in adulthood. A total of 28 working adults representing diverse regions of Turkey, from middle-class backgrounds, aged between 25 and 50, and without any known health conditions, were interviewed to gain insights into their leisure participation during the period September 2021–May 2022.

pmc-11438640.title: Diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of myeloid sarcoma in the oral cavity
pmc-11438640.creator: Melissa Martínez Nieto, Luis Antonio González Gómez, Juan Carlos Gómez Mireles, Sarah Monserrat Lomelí Martínez
pmc-11438640.description: Myeloid sarcoma (MS) is a rare neoplasm characterized by the proliferation of immature myeloid precursor cells outside the bone marrow. The pathogenesis of MS is complex and not completely understood. Moreover, it develops in any extramedullary site of the body.

pmc-11600876.title: Lycorine ameliorates liver steatosis, oxidative stress, ferroptosis and intestinal homeostasis imbalance in MASLD mice
pmc-11600876.creator: Ziwen Wang, Mengpei Zhu, Qian Li, Jiali Cao, Qiangqiang Zhong, Ze Jin, Yumei Huang, Qing Lan, Ya Gao, Zhifan Xiong
pmc-11600876.description: BackgroundMetabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) is the most common liver disease worldwide and few drugs are available for its treatment. Lycorine has effective anti-inflammatory and lipid-lowering effects, but the impact on MASLD is not fully understood. In this study, we intend to test the intervention effect of lycorine on MASLD.

pmc-11608234.title: Deep phenotyping the right ventricle to establish translational MRI biomarkers for characterization of adaptive and maladaptive states in pulmonary hypertension
pmc-11608234.creator: Nicoleta Baxan, Lin Zhao, Ali Ashek, Marili Niglas, Dingyi Wang, Fatemeh Khassafi, Farah Sabrin, Olivier Dubois, Chien-Nien Chen, Soni Savai Pullamsetti, Martin Wilkins, Lan Zhao
pmc-11608234.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Deep phenotyping the right ventricle (RV) is essential for understanding the mechanisms of adaptive and maladaptive RV responses to pulmonary hypertension (PH). In this study, feature selection coupled with machine learning classification/ranking of specific cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) features from cine-MRI, flow-sensitized, and extracellular-volume techniques were used to assess RV remodelling in monocrotaline (MCT) and Sugen hypoxia (SuHx) PH rats. Early physiological changes associated with RV adaptation were detected along with prediction of RV maladaptive outcomes.

pmc-12632210.title: New resistance threat in difficult-to-treat resistance Pseudomonas aeruginosa co-producing AFM and KPC carbapenemases: plasmid dynamic transfer and global phylogeography perspective
pmc-12632210.creator: Haiyang Liu, Jiayao Yao, Chongmei Tian, Pengpeng Min, Longjie Zhou, Wenhao Wu, Minhua Chen, Robert A. Moran, Yunsong Yu, Xi Li
pmc-12632210.description: Metallo-β-lactamase (MBL) production is one of the primary carbapenem resistance mechanisms in carbapenem-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa (CRPA). The emergence of the novel MBL gene blaAFM poses a significant threat to global public health. Concerningly, we have identified clinical CRPA strains co-producing AFM and the widely-disseminated carbapenemase KPC-2.

pmc-12975816.title: Sleeping green: an Italian survey for the assessment of the relationship between sleep and vegetarian diet
pmc-12975816.creator: Maurizio Gorgoni, Alessio Comparelli, Sofia Frappetta, Valentina Alfonsi, Ludovica Annarumma, Elisa Pellegrini, Milena Camaioni, Alessandro Couyoumdjian, Serena Scarpelli, Luigi De Gennaro
pmc-12975816.description: PurposePlant-based diets are beneficial for health and sleep. Nevertheless, results on the relationship between entirely vegetarian (veg) diets and sleep are scarce and heterogeneous, and many relevant variables are rarely considered. We hypothesize that veg diets may be differently related to several sleep measures considering the role of other intervening factors.

pmc-13299267.title: Identification of ANC-3 as a Novel Therapeutic Candidate for Anaplastic Thyroid Cancer Through Drug Screening and Multi-Platform Validation
pmc-13299267.creator: Dorjsuren Tsagaankhuu, Hyunwoo Baek, Jungyoon Choi, Soonyoung Kwon
pmc-13299267.description: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma (ATC) is a rare but highly aggressive malignancy characterized by rapid progression, early metastasis, and extremely poor survival outcomes. Effective therapeutic options remain limited, highlighting the need for efficient and biologically relevant preclinical drug-discovery platforms. In this study, high-throughput compound screening using human ATC cell lines identified ANC-3 as a potential anticancer candidate.

pmc-13457425.title: Personality traits are associated with the development and severity of chemosensory alterations during chemotherapy: a longitudinal study
pmc-13457425.creator: Angelica Lippi, Agnès Giboreau, Véronique Mourier, Christophe Hebert, Renaud Schiappa, Amélie Cougny, Kouceila Touati, Colin Debaigt, Anasthasia Gama, Francesco Claudio Stingo, Mathieu Piquet, Erminio Monteleone, Sara Spinelli
pmc-13457425.description: PurposeChemotherapy-induced sensory alterations are common and may negatively affect nutritional status, treatment adherence and quality of life in people with cancer. However, inter-individual variability in these alterations remains poorly understood. This study examined whether personality traits, food neophobia, disgust sensitivity, and sensitivity to reward, contribute to variability in self-reported sensory alterations during chemotherapy.

pmc-13545803.creator: Mingyue Zou, Tengyu Zhao, Weidong Wu, Jian Zhang, Pengyu Pan, Jingdong Yan, Quan Li, Yanyan Zhou

uslaw-usc-t16-s580i.title: 16 U.S.C. § 580i — Acquisition of winter range, land, and helicopter landing site
uslaw-usc-t16-s580i.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t16-s580i.description: United States Code, Title 16 (Conservation); Chapter 3 (Forests; Forest Service; Reforestation; Management); Subchapter I (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. There are authorized to be appropriated— (a) such sums as may be necessary for the acquisition of parcels of land and interests in land in Sanders County, Montana, needed by the Forest Service to provide winter range for its saddle.

uslaw-usc-t29-s795k.title: 29 U.S.C. § 795k — State plan
uslaw-usc-t29-s795k.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s795k.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 16 (Vocational Rehabilitation And Other Rehabilitation Services); Subchapter VI (Employment Opportunities For Individuals With Disabilities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) State plan supplements To be eligible for an allotment under this subchapter, a State shall submit to the Commissioner, as part of the State plan under section 721 of this title, a State plan.
